tool_schemas.name: ask_perplexity
tool_schemas.description: Executes a single Perplexity ask request for the workspace identified by `api_key` and returns the recorded session, including the generated answer text and (when enabled) citations and optionally the raw provider payload; if an `idempotency_key` is supplied, repeated calls with the same key return the original stored result without re-running the provider request. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, types are invalid, `search_recency_filter` is not one of the allowed values, or generation controls (e.g., `temperature`, `top_p`, `max_tokens`) are out of range; raises UNAUTHORIZED when `api_key` is missing/invalid or not permitted for the target workspace. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED or RATE_LIMITED when workspace usage limits are exceeded, and raises CONFLICT when the same `idempotency_key` is reused with a materially different request payload (e.g., different `question` or `model`).

api_key.description: Per-workspace Perplexity Server API key used to authenticate and attribute usage.

idempotency_key.description: Client-supplied key to deduplicate retries and ensure the same request is not executed twice.

question.description: The user question/query to send to Perplexity.

model.description: Perplexity model identifier to use for the request.

search_recency_filter.description: Optional recency constraint for sources used to answer the question.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature to control response randomness.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the answer.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling parameter for response generation.

return_citations.description: Whether to include citations in the returned answer.

return_provider_payload.description: Whether to include the raw provider payload in the response for debugging/auditing.

tool_schemas.name: get_me
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity resolved from `api_key`, including workspace and API key metadata, granted scopes, and current period quota/rate-limit consumption; refuses with AUTH_ERROR for missing/invalid keys and FORBIDDEN if the key is revoked.

api_key.description: Per-workspace Perplexity Server API key used to authenticate and attribute usage.

tool_schemas.name: list_perplexity_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded Perplexity ask sessions for the authenticated workspace, newest first, with optional filtering; refuses with AUTH_ERROR for missing/invalid keys and FORBIDDEN if the key is revoked.

api_key.description: Per-workspace Perplexity Server API key used to authenticate and attribute usage.

remote_request_id.description: Filter by upstream provider request id (if recorded).

created_after.description: Return only requests created at or after this time (RFC 3339 timestamp).

created_before.description: Return only requests created before this time (RFC 3339 timestamp).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (pagination).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_perplexity_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single recorded Perplexity request by id within the authenticated workspace; refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist in the workspace and FORBIDDEN if the key is revoked.

api_key.description: Per-workspace Perplexity Server API key used to authenticate and attribute usage.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_perplexity_request
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a queued or running Perplexity request; returns the updated request record and refuses with CONFLICT if the request is already in a terminal state or the transition is not allowed.

api_key.description: Per-workspace Perplexity Server API key used to authenticate and attribute usage.

reason.description: Optional human-readable cancellation reason for audit/logging.

tool_schemas.name: list_usage_ledger
tool_schemas.description: Lists usage ledger entries for the authenticated workspace with optional filtering by period, API key, request, and event type; refuses with AUTH_ERROR for missing/invalid keys and FORBIDDEN if the key is revoked.

api_key.description: Per-workspace Perplexity Server API key used to authenticate and attribute usage.

period_ym.description: Filter by billing/usage period in YYYY-MM format.

request_id.description: Filter to ledger entries for a specific request id.

api_key_id.description: Filter to ledger entries attributed to a specific API key id.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (pagination).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: create_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new API key for the authenticated workspace and returns it once (the raw key is only returned on creation); refuses with FORBIDDEN if the workspace is suspended/deleted.

api_key.description: Per-workspace Perplexity Server API key used to authenticate and attribute usage (must be an active key with permission to manage keys).

label.description: Human-readable label to help identify the key.

metadata.name: Perplexity Server
metadata.description: This backend stores Perplexity question/answer sessions executed through a single MCP tool call. It tracks client workspaces, API credentials, individual ask requests, and the returned answers with citations, while enforcing basic lifecycle, idempotency, and quota/rate limits.
